facts.statement: Super Fan Spring Fever was a promotion in which selected games had spring-themed special items or items on sale; Free Realms was one of the selected games.
facts.quote: voyez les jeux sélectionnés pour des objets spéciaux sur le thème du printemps ou des objets en réclame.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a Station Cash promotion news item (French-language page, titled 'Super Fan Spring Fever') on the SOE site, not a Free Realms update. It says that for a short window in late April, buying Station Cash gave double SC, and that Free Realms was one of several SOE games whose items were featured in a promotion. The page gives no details of Free Realms items, prices or content.
